text: Loves tending the small garden out back, especially the tomatoes and rose bushes.
Drinks tea every afternoon around 3pm, usually chamomile.
Reads the newspaper cover to cover every morning with breakfast.
Enjoys a short walk around the block most mornings when the weather allows.
Has a cat named Whiskers who sleeps on the windowsill all day.
Listens to the radio in the evenings, mostly old jazz standards.
Knits scarves and blankets, usually gives them away to grandchildren.
Plays chess online with an old friend twice a week.
Bakes banana bread most weekends, a recipe passed down from her mother.
Waters the houseplants every Sunday without fail.
Watches the evening news at 6pm sharp every day.
Does a crossword puzzle every day to keep the mind sharp.
Goes to the local community center on Tuesdays for a seniors' social hour.
Prefers her coffee black, no sugar, first thing in the morning.
Feeds the birds in the backyard every morning, mostly sparrows and finches.
Goes to a Sunday service most weeks and enjoys the choir.
Likes to do a bit of light stretching before bed most nights.
Enjoys painting watercolors of flowers in the afternoon light.
Calls her sister every Sunday evening to catch up.
Likes to sit on the porch in the late afternoon and watch the neighborhood.
Misses her late husband especially in the evenings when the house feels quiet.
Feels a bit lonely on weekends when the grandchildren can't visit.
Gets anxious before doctor's appointments, always has.
Feels proud whenever her granddaughter calls to share good news about school.
Worries about her son who works too much and doesn't call often enough.
Gets nostalgic looking through old photo albums, especially ones from her wedding.
Feels grateful for the neighbor who checks in on her most days.
Struggles with the anniversary of her husband's passing every spring.
Gets a little sad when old friends stop calling or pass away.
Feels frustrated when she can't do things around the house like she used to.
Enjoys the company of her companion app more than she expected to.
Feels comforted by routine - it's the unpredictable days that unsettle her.
Misses being able to drive herself to places without relying on others.
Feels happiest when the whole family gathers for Sunday dinner.
Gets emotional talking about her childhood home, which no longer stands.
Worries about becoming a burden to her children as she gets older.
Feels a quiet pride in having raised three children mostly on her own.
Gets restless and a little down on rainy days when she can't go outside.
Feels reassured hearing familiar voices, even just on the phone.
Misses dancing, which she used to love before her knees got bad.
Felt a bit dizzy when standing up quickly this morning.
Mentioned her chest felt tight for a few minutes earlier, thought it was probably nothing.
Almost tripped over the rug in the hallway yesterday but caught herself.
Forgot to take her evening blood pressure medication two nights ago.
Had trouble remembering how to get back from the mailbox for a moment.
Noticed some swelling in her ankles that wasn't there before.
Felt short of breath climbing the stairs, more than usual.
Had a small cut on her hand from cooking that wouldn't stop bleeding for a while.
Mentioned feeling unsteady on her feet in the shower this week.
Has been skipping meals some days without really noticing.
Woke up in the night confused about what day it was.
Mentioned her vision has been blurrier than usual the past week.
Had a headache that lasted most of the day, unusual for her.
Ran out of one of her prescriptions and hasn't refilled it yet.
Fell asleep in the chair and woke up with numbness in her arm.
Mentioned ringing in her ears that's been happening on and off.
Had trouble finding the right words mid-sentence a couple of times today.
Noticed her hands have been shakier than usual lately.
Slipped slightly getting out of the bath but didn't fall.
Mentioned feeling unusually tired and weak for several days in a row.
Nice weather today, sunny with a light breeze.
Mentioned the new bakery down the street smells wonderful.
Talked about how the leaves are starting to change color this time of year.
Commented on how quiet the neighborhood has been lately.
Mentioned the mail was a little late today.
Talked about a funny commercial she saw on TV last night.
Mentioned the garbage truck came earlier than usual this week.
Noted that her favorite show got a new season this week.
Mentioned it might rain later based on the clouds outside.
Talked about the price of groceries going up again.
Grew up on a small farm and learned to cook from her grandmother.
Worked as a schoolteacher for over thirty years before retiring.
Has three children and six grandchildren, spread across two states.
Was born in a small coastal town and still talks about the smell of the sea.
Studied piano as a child and still remembers a few pieces by heart.
Served as a volunteer at the local library for many years.
Traveled to Italy once in her thirties and still talks about the food.
Was an avid tennis player when she was younger.
Collects vintage postcards from places she's visited over the years.
Has lived in the same house for over 40 years.
Enjoys doing light gardening chores in the early morning before it gets too warm.
Keeps a small notebook of recipes she wants to try someday.
Prefers soft classical music playing quietly in the background while reading.
Takes a short nap most afternoons after lunch.
Likes to organize her photo albums by year, a project she's slowly working through.
Does a puzzle a little bit each evening, usually a 500-piece landscape.
Writes letters to an old pen pal from her school days a few times a year.
Likes to arrange fresh flowers from the garden on the kitchen table.
Feels a little embarrassed asking for help with the TV remote or phone settings.
Gets quietly happy when a favorite song from her youth comes on the radio.
Feels most at peace sitting in the garden in the early morning quiet.
Gets a little tearful during old movies she used to watch with her husband.
Feels energized after a good phone call with one of the grandchildren.
Worries quietly about her memory not being as sharp as it used to be.
Feels a sense of accomplishment finishing a knitting project.
Mentioned feeling a bit off-balance walking to the bathroom at night.
Has been having trouble sleeping through the night for the past week.
Mentioned a persistent cough that hasn't gone away in several days.
Noticed she's been more forgetful about small daily tasks lately.
Mentioned lower back pain that's been getting worse over the past few days.
Talked about how much she enjoys the smell of rain on a summer afternoon.
Mentioned the neighbor's dog barking a lot this morning.
Talked about a recipe she saw on a cooking show she wants to try.
